component.name: AvatarGroup
component.description: Group of overlapping avatars with optional overflow count.

slots.name: item
slots.description: Individual avatar wrapper used when rendering grouped avatars.

slots.name: count
slots.description: Count indicator shown when a group has more avatars than the visible limit.

slots.name: image
slots.description: Loaded avatar image rendered inside each frame.

slots.name: fallback
slots.description: Text fallback shown while an image is unavailable or failed.

slots.name: fallbackIcon
slots.description: Icon fallback shown when no image or text fallback is available.

slots.name: badge
slots.description: Status or indicator badge anchored to an avatar frame.

props.name: alt
props.description: Accessible alt text for the avatar.

props.name: fallback
props.description: Icon name to show as fallback.

props.name: onStatusChange
props.description: Callback when the loading status of the avatar changes.

props.name: src
props.description: Source URL for the avatar image.

props.name: text
props.description: Initial text to show if image fails or is missing.

own.name: class
own.description: Class applied to the component root or trigger element.

own.name: items
own.description: Array of avatars to render in the group.

own.name: max
own.description: Maximum number of avatars to show.

aria.name: aria-busy
aria.description: Accessibility attribute forwarded by the rendered component.

aria.name: aria-hidden
aria.description: Hides decorative content from assistive technology.

aria.name: aria-label
aria.description: Provides an accessible label when visible text is not sufficient.

data.name: data-loading
data.description: Present when the component is loading.

data.name: data-slot
data.description: Identifies the rendered slot for styling hooks and selectors.

data.name: data-status
data.description: Stores async loading, loaded, or error status.
